subject: Behavioral Economics
title: Default Effect in Marketing
description: Learn Default Effect in Marketing in one minute.

hook.text: A software company pre-checked the annual plan. 70% of users kept it. When monthly was default, only 30% chose annual.

buildup.text: Defaults are the choice you get if you do nothing. Most people accept them because changing requires effort.

discovery.text: Johnson and Goldstein showed organ donation rates differ by 60 percentage points based purely on whether opt-in.

twist.text: Pre-checked boxes for newsletters, add-ons, and insurance exploit this. You agree by not disagreeing.

climax.text: Before submitting any form, uncheck every pre-checked box and re-check only what you genuinely want.

punchline.text: The default is someone else's preference, not yours.

quiz.question: Why are defaults so powerful in marketing?
options: Defaults are always the best option
Most people accept them because changing requires effort
Laws require companies to set optimal defaults
